verdict.rationale: Grok Bot's own features suggest it can work across many items: a scheduled skill can run 'against the current account list', Bots can run in parallel, and one user reports a single bot contacting ~40 suppliers. There is no documented bulk-operation feature, such as selecting many items and applying one action, and no stated limits or batch semantics, so this is inferred from agent iteration and parallelism. Missing for 10: an explicit documented bulk/batch operation capability, documented scale limits and error handling across items, and first-party detail on how a skill iterates over a list.
